title: Stupid Things: Even Stupider
description: A faithful port of the Stupid Things mod for modern versions!
body:
# Welcome to Stupid Things!

This is a mod that adds, well. a lot of stupid things!



From Mine Turtles, to ANvil Backpacks, to Coolers and Heaters. so silly little propeller hats! See everything the mod has to offer with the in game Item Catalog.



# Credits:

The original mod and assets were created by Furgl and ported to modern versions by me under the MIT License. Support Furgl and their projects at https://www.curseforge.com/members/furgl/projects

if you're an original author and wish for the mod to be taken down, dm me on discord at phwee and I'll take care of your request.
